messages:
Aria (Support): Heads-up: Triact's onboarding pipeline is failing at the embed validation step in staging. They're blocked from finishing checklist and asked for a comms plan. Logs below.

Aria (Support): ```
2026-03-24T09:12:02Z embed-api status=429 tenant=triact env=staging route=/v1/embeddings
2026-03-24T09:12:17Z embed-api status=502 tenant=triact upstream=embed-worker
```

prod-bot: New incident TR-INC-441 created (severity: medium) - elevated embed errors for tenant triact (staging).

Sam - CSM: Sam here. Key context: Triact is in a pilot-to-paid window, onboarding due to complete in 3 days. Can Support confirm whether prod is affected? Also need to know customer sentiment and whether they attempted manual retries.

Aria (Support): Prod unaffected. Failures are intermittent in staging only; error rate ~22% over 30m. Customer tried retries but CI job churns many small requests. They've noted frustration and asked if we can rerun validations once stable.

Vera - CS Ops: Looping in SRE and Enablement. Vera will own the comms and renewal note. Quick ops ask: is this likely a long tail issue or transient burst?

Tom (SRE): No config/model changes for triact in 7d. We see a repeated CI job hitting staging with high parallelism (~90). Rate limiter is tripping, proxy returns 502s. Proposed short-term mitigation: temporary bump to per-tenant concurrency + allowlist their staging IP for 30m. Long-term: discuss quota plan if their test pattern persists.

Ivy (Enablement): If they're running CI that aggressively retries, we should offer an enablement session to review best practices for batching and backoff during onboarding. Could be a quick 15-20m pairing session. That both reduces friction and surfaces product feedback.

Sam - CSM: Proposed comms draft: "Hi Luis 0101— we saw transient embed failures in your staging run caused by a high-frequency CI job. Prod is unaffected. We applied a temporary stabilization (concurrency bump + monitoring) and can rerun your onboarding checks. Would you like us to schedule a short enablement call to optimize your test job and avoid future interruptions?" Thoughts?

Vera - CS Ops: Clean. Add explicit ETA: "stabilization applied now, we'll monitor for 45m and revert unless you ask to extend." Also capture in the renewal record that they reported "frustration" so CS should flag potential churn risk if onboarding slips.

Tom (SRE): Applied temp bump at 09:22 UTC and allowlisted staging IP range. Error rate down to ~4% within 6 minutes. Reversion scheduled at 10:07 UTC. Leaving incident in monitoring. Attached trace TR-INC-441.

Aria (Support): Sending comms to customer now. I'll watch for tone and escalate if they push for immediate quota changes.

Ivy (Enablement): I'll reach out to Sam to propose two 20m slots for a pairing session this week. We'll capture recommended CI patterns to add to the onboarding playbook.

Sam - CSM: After customer ack, I'll add a renewal note: "Onboarding hiccup in staging due to CI burst; mitigated quickly; enablement session offered; monitor conversion risk." Vera, please add checklist entry: "staging embed failure -> temp mitigation -> offer enablement -> log sentiment."

Vera - CS Ops: Added checklist entry and linked TR-INC-441. Also creating a feedback ticket for Product to consider adding a retry/backoff doc in onboarding docs.

prod-bot: TR-INC-441 status -> monitoring.

Aria (Support): Customer reply: "Thanks Sam 11, staging is stable and we're happy to take an enablement call. Appreciate the fast help." Closing loop to Sam for renewal note.

Sam - CSM: Marking resolved for now. Will update renewal forecast post-enablement session. If customer requests a permanent quota change, open a billing/ops ticket and update the trial-to-paid risk tracker.
